_comment: Server-side source of truth for prices. The website never sends a price to this server — only a product id and quantity — so this file (or env override) is the ONLY place an order total can come from. Fill in a number (Naira, no commas) to make a product orderable online. Leave null and it stays request-a-quote-only, same as it is on the site today. Only 'fixed' priceType items can ever be sold through checkout; 'quote' items are intentionally excluded below and will be rejected by the API if sent.

deliveryZones._comment: id -> {name, fee}. Fee in Naira. Must match the zone ids the site's checkout form sends.
